note: Canonical diagnostic criteria treat absence of ectopia lentis as a primary discriminator distinguishing Loeys-Dietz syndrome from Marfan syndrome, making reported rare cases plausible misclassifications or phenocopies.

evidence.text: Absence of ectopia lentis is recognized as a major distinguishing feature of Loeys-Dietz syndrome compared to related connective tissue disorders like Marfan syndrome.
